description: React component for creating a new tag via a modal dialog. Includes form fields for tag name, description, allowed models, budget, and limit options.

classes.name: CreateTagModal
classes.description: React functional component for creating a new tag in the UI, handling form submission and modal visibility.

methods.name: handleFinish
methods.description: Handles form submission, calls onSubmit with form values, then resets the form.

methods.name: handleCancel
methods.description: Resets the form and triggers onCancel to close the modal.
